title: Metaphors — English for Kids
skills: identify metaphors in literary and everyday language
analyze how metaphors create imagery and meaning
use metaphors effectively in original writing
alignment_note: Provides a clear foundational explanation of metaphors and how direct comparisons create figurative meaning. Although presented for younger learners, it can serve as a concise review resource for figurative-language recognition, imagery analysis, interpretation, and writing practice across high school English courses.
